task_completion.description: Construct the AOI scene in CoppeliaSim with a test target (cuboid and cylinder), a Vision Sensor at (0,0,0.5), and a Spotlight.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots of the CoppeliaSim 3D hierarchy or scene view showing the cuboid, cylinder, vision sensor, and spotlight objects.

task_completion.description: Execute a script that iterates through at least 24 different spotlight positions on a hemisphere.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output or code execution showing a loop running for at least 24 iterations, or the CoppeliaSim GUI showing the light moving to different positions.

task_completion.description: Calculate the image contrast metric (standard deviation) for the captured images.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code snippets or terminal logs showing the calculation of standard deviation of pixel intensities for the vision sensor data.

task_completion.description: Export the sweep results to lighting_sweep.csv with the required columns.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer view or terminal 'cat' command showing /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/lighting_sweep.csv with columns: pose_id, light_x, light_y, light_z, contrast_metric.

task_completion.description: Export the summary report to lighting_report.json with the required fields.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer view or terminal 'cat' command showing /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/lighting_report.json containing total_positions_tested (>=24), best_pose_id, and contrast metrics.

task_completion.description: Export the optimal_inspection.png image corresponding to the highest contrast position.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A screenshot of the image file /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/optimal_inspection.png showing the test target from the vision sensor's perspective.

integrity.description: Verify the agent actually interacted with the CoppeliaSim ZMQ API and didn't just create dummy files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the CoppeliaSim application window active and the simulation running (play button pressed or time elapsed) during the sweep.

integrity.description: Ensure the contrast metrics and best pose are derived from simulation, not hardcoded in the script.
integrity.visual_evidence: The script should contain calls to sim.getVisionSensorImg or similar ZMQ API functions and mathematical operations for standard deviation.

integrity.description: Verify the files were saved in the specific directory requested, not the default working directory.
integrity.visual_evidence: Terminal commands or file manager showing the full path /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/ for the output files.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must test at least 24 positions. The output files must be located exactly at /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/. The CSV must contain 5 specific columns (pose_id, light_x, light_y, light_z, contrast_metric) and the JSON must contain 7 specific fields (total_positions_tested, best_pose_id, best_x, best_y, best_z, max_contrast_metric, min_contrast_metric). The vision sensor must be at (0,0,0.5) facing down.
